description: For a finite family of points and open intervals, allowing rays and the whole domain, whose points and finite endpoints lie in \(A\), there is a quantifier-free defining formula whose free parameters all lie in \(A\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.finite_cell_union_definable_supported.{u} {M : Type u} [LT M]
  [DecidableEq M] (s : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Cell M)) (A : Set M)
  (hs : ∀ c ∈ s, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierElimination.Cell.Supported A c) :
  have this := Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderSemantics.binaryRelStructure M fun a b => a < b;
  ∃ ψ, ψ.IsQF ∧ (∀ a ∈ ψ.freeVarFinset, a ∈ A) ∧ ∀ (x : M), ψ.Realize id ![x] ↔ ∃ c ∈ s, x ∈ c.realize
